enum mesh_service_adv_cfg_type_t

Enumeration for mesh service advertisement configuration types.

Values:

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_PROV_RETRANS_COUNT

uint8_t Provisioning retransmission count. Default value: 3.

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_PROV_RETRANS_INTERVAL

uint16_t, unit: ms, Provisioning retransmission interval.

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_PROXY_RETRANS_COUNT

uint8_t Proxy retransmission count. Default value: 3.

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_PROXY_RETRANS_INTERVAL

uint16_t, unit: ms, Proxy retransmission interval.

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_PROXY_WITH_BT_ADDR

bool Use Bluetooth address in proxy service advertisements. Default value: false.

enumerator MESH_SERVICE_ADV_CFG_TYPE_UUID_LIST_TYPE

bool Type of UUID list. Default value: false.
